description: Premier Insurance Limited is a Pakistani general insurer conceived in 1952, when Zahid Hussain — the first Governor of the State Bank of Pakistan — brought together leading industrialists to found a domestically owned insurer for the newly independent country. It is listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange, licensed by the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan, and a member of the Insurance Association of Pakistan. It writes all classes of general insurance and distributes motor, travel, home, health and business cover, including motor takaful, with a stated emphasis on prompt claims settlement.
